$comment: Migo Wire Protocol metadata. Normative. See docs/02-protocol.md.

flags.name: TRACED
flags.description: 16-byte trace id + 8-byte span id precede the payload

flags.name: BATCH
flags.description: Payload is varint count then count x (varint len, sub-frame)

flags.name: ERROR
flags.description: Payload is Error instead of the opcode response type

flags.name: ACK_REQUIRED
flags.description: Receiver must acknowledge by cumulative watermark

flags.name: FRAGMENT
flags.description: varint index, varint total follow; payload is a slice

flags.name: RESERVED_6
flags.description: Reserved. MUST be zero. Reserved in MWP/1 for a future METADATA block (section 141); a frame that sets it is rejected.

flags.name: FLAGS_EXT
flags.description: A second flags byte follows (reserved for MWP/2)

delivery_classes.name: Critical
delivery_classes.description: Never dropped. Lagging session is closed with RESUME_REQUIRED instead

delivery_classes.name: Coalescable
delivery_classes.description: Newest replaces oldest for the same coalescing key

delivery_classes.name: Droppable
delivery_classes.description: Dropped silently under pressure, counted in metrics

auth_levels.name: Bot
auth_levels.description: Requires a bot session with the matching capability

auth_levels.name: Server
auth_levels.description: Mesh-internal only. Never accepted from a client socket
